name: EAGLE-3 throughput improvement in SGLang at batch size 64
methodology: SGLang framework, batch size 64. EAGLE-3 with draft tree depth 8. Throughput improvement 1.38x over baseline.
notes: This is a THROUGHPUT measurement at moderate batch size, not a latency measurement at batch 1. The 1.38x at batch 64 should be compared to EAGLE-2's 3-6.5x at batch 1 - the dramatic difference illustrates the batch dilution problem. EAGLE-3 achieves up to 6.5x speedup at batch 1.
